endpoints.notes: DEAD ROUTE as served. Source: /Users/clawdio/odysseus/routes/history_routes.py lines 21-104. Flag for cleanup: frontend likely expects this version's extra keys (model, name, crew_member_id) that the winning handler does not return.

endpoints.purpose: Return a session's full message history (session_routes version — this one WINS over the shadowed history_routes handler at the same path).
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session with messages (use inject_messages). curl -b cookies.txt http://HOST/api/history/<sid>. Expect 200 {"history": [{role, content, ...msg.to_dict() fields}]}. NOTE: response is history-only — no model/name/crew_member_id keys, because the richer history_routes handler at the identical path is shadowed.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown sid -> 404 'Session <sid> not found'.
endpoints.notes: Registered before history_routes' GET /api/history/{session_id} (app.py mounts session router at line 500, history router at line 528), so FastAPI first-match routing serves THIS handler. In-memory only — no DB fallback, no hidden-message filtering (those features live in the unreachable duplicate).

endpoints.purpose: Create a new chat session; optionally validates the model against the endpoint's /v1/models, or binds the chat to an agent (crew member).
endpoints.test_plan: Form-encoded (not JSON): curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session -d 'name=Test Chat' -d 'skip_validation=true'. Expect 200 SessionResponse: {"id": "<uuid>", "name": "Test Chat", "model": "", "rag": false, "archived": false}. With skip_validation=true no network probe happens, so no live model endpoint is needed.
endpoints.bad_input: POST with no endpoint_url and no skip_validation -> 400 'endpoint_url is required (choose from /api/models)'. crew_member_id=nonexistent -> 404 'Agent not found'.
endpoints.notes: Without skip_validation it probes endpoint_url's /v1/models over the network (400 'Cannot reach /v1/models' on failure, 400 'Model not found at server. Available: ...' on mismatch). With crew_member_id of a claude_code agent it REUSES the agent's existing non-archived session instead of creating one (returns that session's id). Fires 'session.created' webhook and 'session_created' event-bus event. endpoint_id form field resolves a stored ModelEndpoint API key into session headers.

endpoints.purpose: Create a session pre-wired to api.openai.com using the server's OPENAI_API_KEY.
endpoints.test_plan: Requires OPENAI_API_KEY set in server env (.env). Form-encoded: curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/openai -d 'model=gpt-4o'. Expect 200 {"id": "<uuid>", "name": "", "model": "gpt-4o"}. No outbound call is made at creation time, but the key must be configured.
endpoints.bad_input: Server without OPENAI_API_KEY -> 400 'Server missing OPENAI_API_KEY'.
endpoints.notes: Session endpoint_url hardcoded to https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions with Bearer header. Fires session_created event. Name form field is accepted but ignored (session saved with name '').

endpoints.purpose: Report the model's real context window length by querying the session's endpoint.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session. curl -b cookies.txt http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/context_info. Expect 200 {"context_length": <int>, "model": "<model>"} when the endpoint is reachable, or {"context_length": null} for sessions without endpoint/model or on any probe failure (never errors).
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown sid -> 404 (from owner check).
endpoints.notes: Makes a network call to the session's model endpoint via src.model_context.get_context_length; degrades gracefully to null. Not an LLM completion — no token spend.

endpoints.purpose: Delete specific messages by DB id (msg_ids) or legacy positional indices.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session with messages; get DB ids from history metadata._db_id (or use legacy indices). curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/delete-messages -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"msg_ids": ["<db-uuid>"]}'. Expect 200 {"status": "ok", "deleted": 1}. Legacy form: -d '{"indices": [0]}'. Empty body keys -> 200 {"status": "ok", "deleted": 0}.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown msg_ids -> 200 {"deleted": 0} (not an error).
endpoints.notes: Updates session.message_count and DbSession.message_count/updated_at. msg_ids takes precedence over indices.

endpoints.purpose: Edit a message's content by its database id, marking metadata.edited=true.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session with a persisted message whose DB id is known (metadata._db_id from history). curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/edit-message -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"msg_id": "<db-uuid>", "content": "corrected text"}'. Expect 200 {"status": "ok"}; history shows new content with metadata.edited=true.
endpoints.bad_input: Missing msg_id or content -> 400 'msg_id and content are required'. Valid shape but unknown msg_id -> 404 'Message not found'.
endpoints.notes: Updates both DB row and in-memory history entry matched by _db_id.

endpoints.purpose: Create a new session containing a copy of the first keep_count messages of the source.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session loaded in memory with >= 2 messages. curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/fork -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"keep_count": 2}'. Expect 200 {"status": "ok", "id": "<new-uuid>", "name": "⫝ <source name>", "kept": 2}; new session appears in GET /api/sessions.
endpoints.bad_input: Session not present in the in-memory manager (only in DB) -> 404 'Session not found'.
endpoints.notes: Uses session_manager.sessions.get() directly (no DB lazy-load), so a session evicted from memory 404s even though it exists. Fork inherits endpoint_url/model/owner, rag=False. Fires session_created event. keep_count defaults to 0 (empty fork).

endpoints.purpose: Star/unstar a session to protect it from deletion and auto-cleanup.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session. Form-encoded: curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/important -d 'important=true'. Expect 200 {"status": "success", "is_important": true}. Then DELETE on the session must 403 until -d 'important=false' is posted.
endpoints.bad_input: important=notabool -> 422 FastAPI bool validation error.
endpoints.notes: Defaults to important=true when field omitted.

endpoints.purpose: Mark the most recent assistant message as user-stopped (metadata.stopped=true).
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session containing at least one assistant message. curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/mark-stopped (no body needed). Expect 200 {"status": "ok"}; last assistant message in history gains metadata.stopped=true and metadata.model.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown session id -> 404 from owner check.
endpoints.notes: No-op success (still 200) if the session has no assistant messages. Persists via save_sessions().

endpoints.purpose: Merge the last two assistant messages into one (post-'continue' stitching), removing the interrupt marker.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session with >= 2 assistant messages (inject user/assistant/user/assistant). curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/merge-last-assistant -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"separator": "\n\n"}'. Expect 200 {"status": "ok", "merged": true}; history now has one combined assistant message. With < 2 assistant messages -> 200 {"status": "ok", "merged": false}.
endpoints.bad_input: Missing body -> 500 (request.json() failure via broad except).
endpoints.notes: Also removes a hidden user 'continue' message containing 'previous response was interrupted' if it sits between the two; drops metadata.stopped from the merged result. Mirrors the merge into DB rows.

endpoints.purpose: Append a single message to a session (slash-command persistence).
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session. curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/message -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"role": "assistant", "content": "saved output", "metadata": {"source": "slash"}}'. Expect 200 {"status": "ok"}; message visible in GET /api/history/<sid>.
endpoints.bad_input: {"content": ""} or missing content -> 400 'content is required'.
endpoints.notes: role defaults to 'assistant' when omitted.

endpoints.purpose: Truncate a session's history down to the first keep_count messages.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session with several messages. curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/truncate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"keep_count": 2}'. Expect 200 {"status": "ok", "kept": 2, "truncated": <result of session_manager.truncate_messages>}.
endpoints.bad_input: Missing/non-JSON body -> request.json() raises -> caught by broad except -> 500 with the parse error string.
endpoints.notes: keep_count defaults to 0 (wipes all messages) when omitted — destructive to a single session's messages but ordinary CRUD scope.

endpoints.purpose: Merge arbitrary metadata into the last assistant message (e.g. saving response variants).
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session with an assistant message. curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/update-last-meta -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"metadata": {"variants": ["alt response"], "rating": 5}}'. Expect 200 {"status": "ok"}; keys merged into last assistant message metadata in both memory and DB.
endpoints.bad_input: Missing/non-JSON body -> 500 (request.json() failure caught by broad except).
endpoints.notes: Shallow dict merge (update); existing keys are overwritten.

endpoints.purpose: Permanently delete one session and all its messages.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own non-starred session sid. curl -b cookies.txt -X DELETE http://HOST/api/session/<sid>. Expect 200 {"status": "deleted"}.
endpoints.bad_input: Starred session -> 403 SESSION_STARRED detail. Unknown sid -> 404 (owner check fires first with 'Session ... not found').
endpoints.notes: Ordinary delete-one CRUD, not DESTRUCTIVE class. Owner check returns 404 for other users' sessions (no existence leak).

endpoints.purpose: Update session attributes: rename, move to folder, switch model/endpoint mid-session, bind/unbind an agent.
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session sid. Form-encoded: curl -b cookies.txt -X PATCH http://HOST/api/session/<sid> -d 'name=Renamed Chat' -d 'folder=Work'. Expect 200 {"id": "<sid>", "name": "Renamed Chat", "folder": "Work"}. Model switch requires BOTH model and endpoint_url fields together.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown sid -> 404 'Session ... not found' (also returned when sid belongs to another user). crew_member_id=bogus -> 404 'Agent not found'. model+endpoint_url with a deleted endpoint_id -> 400 'Model endpoint no longer exists'.
endpoints.notes: All Form fields optional; only provided ones are applied. crew_member_id of '', '__default__', 'none', 'default' unbinds the agent (crew_member_id -> null in response).

endpoints.purpose: Archive a session (kept in DB, hidden from the active list).
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own session sid. curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/archive. Expect 200 {"status": "archived"}; session then appears in GET /api/sessions/archived and not in GET /api/sessions.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown sid -> 404 "Session '<sid>' not found".
endpoints.notes: Sets archived=true in DB and in memory.

endpoints.purpose: Delete a session via POST (navigator.sendBeacon alias for the DELETE route).
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: own disposable (non-starred) session sid. curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://HOST/api/session/<sid>/delete. Expect 200 {"status": "deleted"}. Subsequent GET /api/history/<sid> -> 404.
endpoints.bad_input: Starred session (is_important=true) -> 403 {"detail": {"error": "SESSION_STARRED", "message": "Unstar the session before deleting it"}}.

endpoints.purpose: Create a scheduled/event/webhook-triggered task (llm | action | research)
endpoints.test_plan: POST /api/tasks JSON {"name": "Hello task", "prompt": "Say hello", "task_type": "llm", "schedule": "daily", "scheduled_time": "09:00", "trigger_type": "schedule"} → 200 task dict with id (uuid), status "active", non-null next_run, crew_member_id set to the user's default assistant. endpoints.bad_input: Unknown task_id → 404 "Task not found".

endpoints.purpose: Stop a currently-running task execution
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: a long task started via POST /api/tasks/<id>/run. POST /api/tasks/<id>/stop → 200 {"ok": true, "message": "Task stopped"}.
endpoints.bad_input: Stop a task that is not running → 404 "Task is not running".
endpoints.notes: Easiest deterministic test is the 404 path; the happy path needs a run in flight.

endpoints.purpose: Rotate a task's webhook token
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: any owned task. POST /api/tasks/<id>/webhook-regenerate → 200 {"ok": true, "webhook_token": "<new 43-char urlsafe token>"}. Old token then 404s on the trigger endpoint.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown id → 404.
endpoints.notes: Works even on non-webhook tasks (just sets the column).

endpoints.purpose: List all registered outbound webhooks (secrets never returned, only has_secret)
endpoints.test_plan: As admin: GET /api/webhooks → 200 JSON array (possibly []) of {id, name, url, has_secret, events[], is_active, last_triggered_at, last_status_code, last_error, created_at}.
endpoints.bad_input: Non-admin session → 403 "Admin only".
endpoints.notes: require_admin passes when AUTH_ENABLED=false, auth unconfigured fails with 403, internal-tool header bypasses.

endpoints.purpose: Register an outbound webhook (name, url, optional secret, comma-separated events)
endpoints.test_plan: FORM-encoded (not JSON): curl -X POST /api/webhooks -d 'name=CI hook' -d 'url=https://example.com/hook' -d 'events=chat.completed' → 200 {"id": "<8-char>", "name": "CI hook"}. Allowed events: session.created, chat.completed, chat.message, webhook.test.
endpoints.bad_input: events=bogus → 400 "Invalid events: bogus. Allowed: ..."; url=http://127.0.0.1/x or any private/internal address → 400 "URL must not point to private/internal addresses"; empty name → 400 "Webhook name is required".
endpoints.notes: Form fields, application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Secret encrypted at rest via api_key_manager Fernet (plaintext fallback if unavailable). SSRF guard rejects private nets — use a public URL like https://example.com for happy path; deliveries to it will just fail harmlessly.

endpoints.purpose: Delete one registered webhook
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: throwaway webhook. DELETE /api/webhooks/<id> → 200 {"status": "deleted"}.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown id → 404 "Webhook not found".

endpoints.purpose: Toggle a webhook's is_active flag (no body — pure toggle)
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: existing webhook (created active). PATCH /api/webhooks/<id> → 200 {"id": "<id>", "is_active": false}; PATCH again → is_active true.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown id → 404 "Webhook not found".
endpoints.notes: CAVEAT: app-level CORS only allows GET/POST/PUT/DELETE — PATCH from a browser cross-origin would fail preflight; direct curl is fine.

endpoints.purpose: Send a webhook.test delivery to the registered URL
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: webhook created via POST /api/webhooks. POST /api/webhooks/<id>/test → 200 {"status": "sent"} regardless of whether the remote URL accepted it (delivery result lands in last_status_code/last_error on the next GET /api/webhooks).
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown webhook_id → 404 "Webhook not found".
endpoints.notes: Makes an outbound HTTP POST (httpx, 10s timeout, no redirects) — needs egress; safe to point at httpbin/webhook.site for verification.

endpoints.purpose: Same-origin proxy for OpenMoji monochrome line-art emoji SVGs, lazily fetched from jsdelivr CDN and disk-cached
endpoints.test_plan: Logged-in session: curl -b cookies.txt http://HOST/api/emoji/1f600.svg -> 200 Content-Type image/svg+xml. With network to cdn.jsdelivr.net: real glyph body containing '<svg', header Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable; cached to data/emoji_cache/1f600.svg so a second call serves from disk (works offline thereafter). Multi-codepoint form also valid: /api/emoji/1f468-200d-1f469-200d-1f467.svg.
endpoints.bad_input: Invalid code (e.g. /api/emoji/zzz!.svg) or unknown codepoint -> STILL 200 with a blank 1x1 transparent SVG and Cache-Control: no-store — this endpoint never 404s.
endpoints.notes: Outbound HTTPS to https://cdn.jsdelivr.net (8s timeout) only on cache miss; offline first-fetch degrades to blank SVG, not an error. Code must match ^[0-9a-f]{2,6}(-[0-9a-f]{2,6})*$ (lowercased). No per-route auth; gated by global AuthMiddleware.

endpoints.purpose: List user-supplied font files in static/fonts/custom/ grouped by derived family name
endpoints.test_plan: Logged-in session: curl -b cookies.txt http://HOST/api/fonts/custom -> 200 {"fonts":{}} on a clean install. Optional richer fixture: copy any .woff2/.ttf into static/fonts/custom/ (e.g. JetBrainsMono-Regular.woff2) then expect {"fonts":{"Jet Brains Mono":[{"file":"JetBrainsMono-Regular.woff2","url":"/static/fonts/custom/JetBrainsMono-Regular.woff2","format":"woff2"}]}}.
endpoints.notes: No per-route auth check (session enforced only by global AuthMiddleware). Creates static/fonts/custom/ on first call. Only .ttf/.otf/.woff/.woff2 listed.

endpoints.purpose: List the current user's saved visual signatures (base64 PNG stamps), newest first
endpoints.test_plan: Logged-in session: curl -b cookies.txt http://HOST/api/signatures -> 200 {"signatures":[{"id":"<uuid>","name":"...","data_url":"data:image/png;base64,...","width":W,"height":H,"created_at":"...Z"}]} (empty list on fresh install). Strict ownership filter when a user is resolved.
endpoints.notes: If no user resolves (auth disabled / internal), returns ALL signatures (no filter applied).

endpoints.purpose: Create a signature from base64 PNG data (data: URL prefix optional)
endpoints.test_plan: curl -X POST -b cookies.txt -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Test Sig","data":"iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==","width":1,"height":1}' http://HOST/api/signatures -> 200 {"id":"<uuid>","name":"Test Sig","data_url":"data:image/png;base64,iVBOR...","width":1,"height":1,"created_at":"..."}. Save the id as the fixture for DELETE.
endpoints.bad_input: {"data":"%%%not-base64"} -> 400 'Signature data must be base64-encoded PNG bytes'. Missing data -> 422.
endpoints.notes: Accepts raw base64 or data:image/(png|jpeg|jpg);base64,... prefix. Only validates base64 decodability, not actual PNG bytes. Stored in SQL (Signature table) with owner=current user; name defaults to 'Signature'.

endpoints.purpose: Delete one of the user's signatures by id
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: POST /api/signatures first, take id. curl -X DELETE -b cookies.txt http://HOST/api/signatures/<id> -> 200 {"deleted":"<id>"}.
endpoints.bad_input: Unknown id -> 404 'Signature not found'. Another user's id -> 403 'Not your signature'.
endpoints.notes: Ordinary delete-one CRUD, not DESTRUCTIVE class.

endpoints.purpose: Upload one or more files (multipart) with sanitization, dedupe, type/size checks; returns metadata per file
endpoints.test_plan: With a logged-in session cookie: curl -b cookies.txt -F 'files=@test.png' http://HOST/api/upload  (form field name must be 'files'; repeat -F for multiple). Expect 200 {"files":[{"id":"<32-hex>.png","name":"test.png","mime":"image/png","size":N,"hash":"...","uploaded_at":"...","width":W,"height":H,"is_duplicate":false}]}. The id matches ^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$ and is the fixture for the GET/vision endpoints.
endpoints.bad_input: Upload a file named evil.exe (or an empty 0-byte file) -> 400 'File type not allowed: ...' / 400 'File is empty'. Sixth upload within 60s from same IP -> 429 'Upload rate limit exceeded'.
endpoints.notes: Rate limits: 5 uploads/min/IP, max_concurrent_uploads=3 (429), max size 10MB (400). Dedupes by SHA hash per owner (is_duplicate=true returns existing id). Files stored under UPLOAD_DIR/YYYY/MM/DD, index in UPLOAD_DIR/uploads.json with owner=current user. Blocked extensions: .exe .dll .bat .cmd .vbs .ps1 .jsp .asp .aspx.

endpoints.purpose: Manually trigger deletion of uploaded files older than 30 days
endpoints.test_plan: Admin session, no body: curl -X POST -b admin_cookies.txt http://HOST/api/upload/cleanup -> 200 {"status":"success","files_cleaned":0} (0 on a fresh install). Non-admin session -> 403 'Admin only'.
endpoints.notes: Side effect: permanently deletes uploads older than cleanup_days=30. Safe on fresh test data (nothing >30d old) but do not run against a long-lived instance you care about.

endpoints.purpose: Return aggregate statistics about uploaded files
endpoints.test_plan: Admin session: curl -b admin_cookies.txt http://HOST/api/upload/stats -> 200 JSON stats dict from upload_handler.get_upload_stats() (file counts/sizes). Works with zero uploads. Non-admin -> 403 'Admin only'.
endpoints.notes: Read-only. 500 only if stats computation throws.

endpoints.purpose: Download an uploaded file by ID; ?thumb=1 returns a cached 320px JPEG thumbnail for images
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: POST /api/upload first as the same user; take files[0].id. Then curl -b cookies.txt http://HOST/api/upload/<id> -> 200 raw file bytes, Content-Type guessed from extension, Content-Disposition uses original filename. For an image, add ?thumb=1 -> 200 image/jpeg thumbnail (cached under UPLOAD_DIR/.thumbs/).
endpoints.bad_input: GET /api/upload/not-a-valid-id -> 400 'Invalid file ID' (must match ^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$). Valid-format but nonexistent id (32 hex chars + .png) -> 404 'File not found'.
endpoints.notes: Ownership: when auth is configured, a non-owner non-admin gets 404; unauthenticated gets 403. Thumbnail generation needs Pillow; on failure falls through to full image. Walks UPLOAD_DIR tree to locate the file.

endpoints.purpose: Persist user-edited vision/OCR text override for an attachment (written to the same vision cache file)
endpoints.test_plan: Fixture: upload a file as the same user (must exist in uploads.json). curl -X PUT -b cookies.txt -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"my corrected OCR text"}' http://HOST/api/upload/<id>/vision -> 200 {"ok":true}. Verify by GET .../vision -> {"text":"my corrected OCR text","cached":true}.
endpoints.bad_input: {"text": 123} -> 400 'text must be a string'. Valid-format unknown id -> 404 'File not found'.
endpoints.notes: No image-mime check on PUT (works on any owned upload). Owner/admin-only when auth configured. Subsequent chat sends pick this text up as the vision override.

endpoints.purpose: Return Vaultwarden/Bitwarden CLI config (server URL, email, unlocked flag, bw_installed) without secrets
endpoints.test_plan: Admin session: curl -b admin_cookies.txt http://HOST/api/vault/config -> 200 {"server_url":"","email":"","unlocked":false,"unlocked_at":"","bw_installed":false} on a clean install (bw_installed true only if the bw CLI is on PATH). Non-admin -> 403.
endpoints.notes: Runs 'bw --version' as a subprocess to compute bw_installed; safe without bw (returns false). Reads data/vault.json.

endpoints.purpose: Save Vaultwarden server URL + email; runs 'bw config server <url>' when URL non-empty
endpoints.test_plan: Happy path WITHOUT needing the bw CLI: curl -X POST -b admin_cookies.txt -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"server_url":"","email":"vault@example.com"}' http://HOST/api/vault/config -> 200 {"ok":true} (empty server_url skips the bw subprocess). With a non-empty server_url and no bw CLI installed -> 200 {"ok":false,"error":"bw config failed: bw CLI not installed..."}.
endpoints.bad_input: Missing required fields is impossible (both default to ""), but a non-JSON body -> 422 from Pydantic.
endpoints.notes: Side effect: writes data/vault.json (chmod 600 on POSIX). Errors are returned as HTTP 200 with ok:false — assert on the JSON body, not the status code.

endpoints.purpose: Lock the vault: clear stored session from data/vault.json and run 'bw lock'
endpoints.test_plan: Admin session, no body: curl -X POST -b admin_cookies.txt http://HOST/api/vault/lock -> 200 {"ok":true,"message":"Vault locked"}. Always succeeds — the 'bw lock' subprocess result is ignored, so this is testable without bw CLI or any vault setup.
endpoints.notes: Idempotent; pops session/unlocked_at keys from data/vault.json.

endpoints.purpose: Log in to Vaultwarden via 'bw login <email> --raw', storing the session key on success
endpoints.test_plan: Requires bw CLI installed AND a reachable Vaultwarden account: curl -X POST -b admin_cookies.txt -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"vault@example.com","master_password":"correct-horse"}' http://HOST/api/vault/login -> 200 {"ok":true} (or {"ok":true,"already":true} if already logged in). Without bw CLI: 200 {"ok":false,"error":"Login failed: bw CLI not installed..."} — that ok:false path is the realistic smoke test in a credless environment.
endpoints.bad_input: Body missing master_password -> 422 validation error.
endpoints.notes: Spawns bw subprocess, pipes password to stdin. Saves email (always) and session+unlocked_at (on success) to data/vault.json. Failures return HTTP 200 with ok:false. Won't capture session if account has 2FA.

endpoints.purpose: Run 'bw logout' and clear session+email from the stored vault config
endpoints.test_plan: Admin session, no body: curl -X POST -b admin_cookies.txt http://HOST/api/vault/logout -> 200 {"ok":true}. Always succeeds regardless of bw CLI presence (subprocess result ignored).
endpoints.notes: Side effect: removes session, email, unlocked_at from data/vault.json; subsequent GET /api/vault/config shows email:"" and unlocked:false. Run vault tests in order: config -> lock/logout last.

endpoints.purpose: Unlock the vault via 'bw unlock <password> --raw' and persist the BW_SESSION key
endpoints.test_plan: Requires bw CLI + prior login: curl -X POST -b admin_cookies.txt -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"master_password":"correct-horse"}' http://HOST/api/vault/unlock -> 200 {"ok":true,"message":"Vault unlocked"}. Without bw CLI: 200 {"ok":false,"error":"Unlock failed: bw CLI not installed..."}.
endpoints.bad_input: {} -> 422 (master_password required).
endpoints.notes: WARNING: master password is passed as a subprocess argv (visible in process list). Stores session in data/vault.json. HTTP 200 with ok:false on failure.
